title: Catch-up plan — 13 Oct to 25 Nov 2026
rules: A missed day pushes everything back one slot. Never double up.
On a bad day drop pathophysiology first, then pharmacology. Never drop the next exam’s subject.
Nothing new after swim training — Tuesday and Thursday evenings are review only.
ECG comes from the LITFL ECG Library (litfl.com/ecg-library/basics) — reading and strips, no video.
Wednesday and Friday have the least slack. Move work to Saturday, not into them.
Micro MT1 and the German MT are both on 29 Oct 2026. Micro MT1 is IV 12–37, parasites only — no mycology.
German is a closed list, so it crams. Micro does not. On exam morning the last thing you read is the German sheet.
Pathophysiology has no exam in this plan and is shed first whenever a day runs over 215 minutes.
Pharm runs A1–A9 as a foundation pass (31 Oct–4 Nov) then A10–A22 at full depth (7–13 Nov). A1–A9 are not on MT2 but are on the winter semifinal, so they are covered properly, not skipped.
Pharm stays suspended 22–28 Oct and off 5 Nov (Micro MT2 eve).
A winter semifinal covers the whole pharm year. Nothing in A1–A22 gets dropped — only resequenced.
